source_description: GitHub issue kentonium3/kg-automation#115 (Infra: Automated credential expiry health check, R-003). Discovery confirmed alert path = GitHub issue (primary, audit trail) + Vikunja task with due_date = boundary - 7 days (action driver via existing escalation engine). Out of scope: discovering credentials missing from the manifest (post-deploy Kent audit) and the monitor-activity activity-signal check (deferred if it requires new instrumentation).
